description.en: Crafts and throws armors with drones to other zombies.
description.zh: 制作并向其他僵尸投出带有无人机的盔甲。

chat.en: Obviously, instead of having drones slowly come over from their air base, it's better to charge straight into the fray, making and sending the drones right on the spot!
chat.zh: 很显然，与其让无人机从基地慢悠悠地飞过来，不如冲锋陷阵，现场组装分发无人机！

text.en: drones will equip basic zombies with helmets and use them as strongholds for its further actions
text.zh: 无人机将给一般的僵尸戴上头盔，并以其为据点行动

text.en: drones frequently leave their strongholds, fly towards plants on the lawn, and damage them
text.zh: 无人机会时常离开据点，飞向场上的植物并啃食
